metadata.description: Formify e-signature and identity verification for AI agents

plugins.name: formify
plugins.description: For any business that needs e-signature — not industry-specific. Build fillable PDF forms and contracts, send them for signature or publish one signing link, verify signers with BankID or an ID scan, and track what happens after sending. Choose Formify + Spanish Real Estate instead if you are an estate agent in Spain.

plugins.name: formify-es-real-estate
plugins.description: Formify plus the Spanish real-estate niche. For estate agents in Spain: nota de encargo, buyer/seller KYC, oferta y reserva, contrato de arras, inter-agency collaboration and key handover — bilingual, region-correct, ready to sign. Includes the full Formify skill set, so you do not need to install Formify separately.
